name: Bethor's Scroll
summary: Bethor Iceshard writes counter-incantations for Apothecary Renferrel at the Sepulcher. The scroll may help him brew a protective draught against Thule Ravenclaw's dark sorcery on Fenris Isle.

sections.title: Countering the Necromancer
sections.body: Bethor Iceshard writes arcane formulas to help the Royal Apothecary Society brew a restorative potion. At the Sepulcher, Apothecary Renferrel receives the scroll. Its incantations counter the weakening hexes Thule casts around his fortress.

sections.title: A Colleague's Betrayal
sections.body: Tainted ichor from Rot Hide gnolls bears Thule Ravenclaw's mark, and Bethor Iceshard knows his spellcraft. Thule was once a promising young mage of the Kirin Tor. When the Scourge rose to power, he betrayed his brethren and served the Lich King. Bethor learns that Thule survived and directs Rot Hide attacks across Silverpine Forest from Fenris Isle. So Bethor writes the scroll, drawing on his knowledge of a former colleague.

faq.q: What is written on Bethor's Scroll?
faq.answer: Bethor Iceshard inscribes arcane incantations that guide the brewing of an alchemical counter-potion. He studied alongside Thule Ravenclaw and knows the spells the necromancer favors.

aliases: who do i give the scroll to
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel receives the scroll at the Sepulcher in Silverpine Forest. He uses its magic to make a protective draught.

faq.q: Why does Apothecary Renferrel need magical incantations for a potion?
aliases: why does an apothecary need spells
faq.answer: Apothecary Renferrel practices alchemy rather than traditional sorcery, and rarely weaves such overt forces into his brews. Ordinary anti-toxins cannot pierce the Scourge curses shielding Thule. Bethor's arcane formulas can make the potion effective.

faq.q: Who was Thule Ravenclaw before turning to the Scourge?
faq.answer: Before the Third War, Thule Ravenclaw was a promising young human mage and an associate of Bethor Iceshard. When the Lich King marshaled his undead armies, Thule abandoned his fellow spellcasters and pledged loyalty to the Scourge.

angles.text: As a mage, you know how a spellcaster's signature magic can be turned against them. The scroll recalls the Kirin Tor's fractured past.
As an undead, you see Forsaken spellcasters and apothecaries join their talents through this parchment. It brings Dalaran's old arcane training together with the Sepulcher's alchemical craft.
